BrochureContent.Content:
Bowe Property present to the market, Seaglass, a truly stunning property in terms of its setting, outlook, great design and its wonderful lifestyle offering. Located within Sandycove just 2km from Kinsale town, this private residential area sits on a natural bay/inlet protected by Sandycove Island from the Atlantic Ocean and framing an exquisitely perfect Irish Atlantic landscape. Seaglass was curated from an earlier, more modest residential offering in 2010 with a local owner who grew up in the area knowing everything about the setting and the location and in partnership with James Leahy and Leahy & Associates Architects, designed a wonderful front line coastal home capturing everything that Sandycove and its setting offers. The owner's personal taste and appointment presents Seaglass as a wonderful, warm home with coastal lifestyle living at its best. Set over two floors, the property has four bedrooms all with breathtaking views of Sandycove Bay and Island. The accommodation is complimented by two family bathrooms, a well appointed utility area, spacious entrance hall, lounge and a truly beautiful open plan kitchen/dining/living area with a large al-fresco glazed and stainless steel balcony floating above the bay with uninterrupted 180 degree views capturing the perfect coastal scene. A private balcony off the Master Bedroom compliment the outside areas which include private patio, gardens, side private decks with a feature hybrid electric wooden hot tub, offering perfect privacy with open exquisite views. The property has been carefully designed to maximise its setting blending seamlessly into the landscape hiding its scale with perfect privacy behind roadside magnetised, pedestrian gates. Basement style garage and water activity store further adds to the practicality of the home for storage of kayaks, surfboards and all one requires to enjoy active coastal living. Offered now for sale for the first time, Seaglass is a very rare opportunity to acquire a beautiful, contemporary and warm architect designed seaside home with frontline views offering a superb coastal lifestyle in one of Kinsale's most exclusive and private settings. A truly stunning home in a naturally beautiful location with exceptionally exquisite views in every direction. 

Viewings strictly by prior application with the sole selling agents.
